eventHandler.timingRule: Store events at integer source frames and serialize normalizedTime only as evidence; runtime orders by actionSequence, clip local time, then eventOrdinal and deduplicates retries.
eventHandler.authorityRule: Events synchronize or request presentation. They never create damage, healing, movement permission, control, resource cost, cooldown, loot, or state results.

eventDefinitions.purpose: Request a cataloged owned audio cue at a presentation moment.

payloadFields.name: normalizedTime
payloadFields.rule: Inclusive zero through one evidence value.

payloadFields.name: cueId
payloadFields.rule: Exact cataloged audio cue ID; never a Resources path.

eventDefinitions.purpose: Declare the beginning of a measured foot, limb, body, prop, or surface contact interval.

payloadFields.name: normalizedTime
payloadFields.rule: Inclusive zero through one evidence value.

payloadFields.name: contactId
payloadFields.rule: Canonical socket or semantic contact name.

eventDefinitions.purpose: Declare the end of a measured contact interval.

payloadFields.name: normalizedTime
payloadFields.rule: Inclusive zero through one evidence value.

payloadFields.name: contactId
payloadFields.rule: Must match an open contact begin in the same action sequence.

eventDefinitions.purpose: Request opening a named gameplay window after authoritative action and phase checks.

payloadFields.name: actionSequence
payloadFields.rule: Must match the authoritative active action.

payloadFields.name: normalizedTime
payloadFields.rule: Inclusive zero through one evidence value.

eventDefinitions.purpose: Request closing a named gameplay window; cancellation and interruption close it even if this event is absent.

payloadFields.name: actionSequence
payloadFields.rule: Must match the authoritative active or just-ended action.

payloadFields.name: normalizedTime
payloadFields.rule: Inclusive zero through one evidence value.

payloadFields.name: windowId
payloadFields.rule: Must match a requested window in the same action sequence.

eventDefinitions.purpose: Expose the beginning of a presentation cancel window while gameplay remains authoritative.

payloadFields.name: normalizedTime
payloadFields.rule: Inclusive zero through one evidence value.

eventDefinitions.purpose: Expose the end of a presentation cancel window.

payloadFields.name: normalizedTime
payloadFields.rule: Inclusive zero through one evidence value.

payloadFields.name: windowId
payloadFields.rule: Must match an open cancel-window ID.

eventDefinitions.purpose: Synchronize presentation entry to a canonical action or skill phase.

payloadFields.name: actionSequence
payloadFields.rule: Must match the authoritative active action.

payloadFields.name: normalizedTime
payloadFields.rule: Inclusive zero through one evidence value.

payloadFields.name: phase
payloadFields.rule: One canonical skill phase or declared non-skill phase.

eventDefinitions.purpose: Synchronize presentation exit from a canonical phase without authorizing the next phase.

payloadFields.name: actionSequence
payloadFields.rule: Must match the authoritative active or just-ended action.

payloadFields.name: normalizedTime
payloadFields.rule: Inclusive zero through one evidence value.

payloadFields.name: phase
payloadFields.rule: Must match the entered phase in the same action sequence.

eventDefinitions.purpose: Request a cataloged owned VFX cue attached to a canonical socket.

payloadFields.name: normalizedTime
payloadFields.rule: Inclusive zero through one evidence value.

payloadFields.name: cueId
payloadFields.rule: Exact VFX catalog ID; socket and lifetime come from that binding.

skillPhases.authorityRule: Communicates intent before commit; cannot spend resources or apply results.
Follows gameplay cast state and may be interruptible; clip duration never changes configured cast duration.
Required only for channeled skills; gameplay confirms channel entry.
Loops while gameplay channel remains active and exits on authoritative stop or interruption.
Mirrors a committed gameplay receipt; an animation event cannot create commit.
Required for projectile, beam, summon, thrown, or visibly released skills after commit.
Plays only from authoritative contact or result evidence and never predicts damage.
Returns to a legal locomotion or idle state within the bounded recovery time.
Required when gameplay interruption is possible; closes presentation windows without undoing an already committed result.
Required when pre-commit cancellation is possible and returns to a declared safe state.

requiredSets.notes: Every declared locomotion mode and skill makes its conditional keys mandatory; anatomy-specific omissions require a versioned exception, not silent deletion.
Every named boss phase or transition adds its own versioned motion key and must preserve telegraph and interruption readability on mobile.
Every cataloged skill declares applicability for all ten phases; conditional phases become mandatory when the gameplay skill can channel, release, impact, interrupt, cancel, climb, or vault.
Every declared locomotion mode, traversal capability, and skill expands the mandatory set. Bosses use the separate boss set.
A noncombat role still needs its explicit safe reactions and role-life set; combat-only keys may become not applicable only through a role-specific approved binding with rationale.

Exactly the six source-bounded presentations: rest/vent, scurry, plant-stop, cut, spoil-push, and turn. Attack, defeat, burrow, standing-rest, and additional clips are blocked until owner authorization.

anatomyExceptions.requiredTreatment: Define support datum, buoyancy-facing axis, propulsion chains, and surface/bottom contact separately; root vertical motion remains gameplay-owned unless traversal authorizes it.
anatomyExceptions.forbiddenAssumption: Do not require ground contacts or a standing bind pose for a fully aquatic anatomy.

anatomyExceptions.requiredTreatment: Use explicit wing, leg, contact, center-of-mass, ground, takeoff, flight, and landing semantics; airborne contacts are not fabricated.
anatomyExceptions.forbiddenAssumption: Do not map wings to arms merely to obtain Humanoid retargeting.

anatomyExceptions.requiredTreatment: Declare every limb and gait phase explicitly; semantic-chain retargeting requires equal contact count, chain order, phase offsets, and center-of-mass behavior.
anatomyExceptions.forbiddenAssumption: Do not truncate extra limbs or reuse quadruped event timing by index.

anatomyExceptions.requiredTreatment: Preserve the approved recumbent bind, derive exact-signature roots and semantic contacts in a new version, and author only the six authorized Slagwhistle presentations.
anatomyExceptions.forbiddenAssumption: Do not invent standing, combat, defeat, or burrow motion from the species label.

anatomyExceptions.requiredTreatment: Use ordered axial segments, declared support/contact regions, curvature limits, and exact or explicitly mapped chain signatures.
anatomyExceptions.forbiddenAssumption: Do not synthesize pelvis, feet, or stride contacts to fit a biped or quadruped template.
